messages:
tom (AE): FYI Asterion Therapeutics (ACCT-AST-77) card declined for INV-2026-02-117 ($52,300). they just emailed asking for a partial credit: claim a platform incident caused a flood of eval traffic and inflated charges.
emma (Billing): thanks tom. did they send logs or an internal incident number? we need something formal to consider any credit.
tom (AE): they attached a CSV usage export + their internal ticket #INC-8742. says spike on 2026-02-02 where 70% of tokens came from a retry loop.
raj (Collections): hold dunning for now until we validate. if they want credit we need usage reconciliation and a signed settlement agreement. no waiving until finance approves.
maya (Finance): quick heads-up — credits > $5k need VP finance signoff, and > $25k need CFO. $52k invoice so if we propose credit over $10k loop me in early.
lena (Legal): we'll need the settlement language: customer acknowledges receipt of service, agrees dispute limited to this invoice, and payment schedule if split. also include clause preserving termination rights.
emma (Billing): support-bot: retry attempt 1/3 failed (insufficient funds). logged as auth decline. retry in 24h.
support-bot: Automated: card retry scheduled for INV-2026-02-117  attempt 2/3 at 2149998421.
raj (Collections): propose options to customer: a) immediate full payment minus agreed credit b) two-pay plan: 50% now, 50% in 30 days c) short extension with ACH mandate + security deposit. any preference?
tom (AE): customer asked for 40% refund and to split remaining 60% into 2 equal payments. they said they're cash-constrained due to a delayed grant.
maya (Finance): 40% credit on $52,300 = $20,920. that would need CFO signoff. if they accept a 2-pay plan for the remaining $31,380, require payment method on file and missed-payment revert clause.
lena (Legal): i'll draft a 2-paragraph settlement addendum requiring signed acceptance and explicit acknowledgement of the corrected usage CSV. also include data retention note for reconciliation docs.
raj (Collections): operational checklist: need signed settlement + reconciliation CSV accepted by billing + payment method token or ACH mandate. once received i'll set payment_plan:active and mute dunning-bot.
tom (AE): I'll send the settlement proposal now with the CSV attached. proposed wording: "We agree to credit $20,920 for usage between 2026-02-02 and 2026-02-03 after reconciliation. The remaining $31,380 payable as 2 installments: 2026-03-05 $15,690 and 2026-04-05 $15,690. Missed payment => 7-day cure then collections"
emma (Billing): add line: "no retroactive credits beyond reconciled window" and require reconciliation confirmation before first installment posts.
maya (Finance): please add a requirement that final signoff from their CFO is included in the reply. that speeds internal approval.
 support-bot: Automated notice: ACH mandate requested. Micro-deposits will take 48-72 hours.
dunning-bot: Automated: reminder scheduled unless payment_plan flag set (next reminder 2149999020).
raj (Collections): if they sign and provide ACH we'll set plan and pause dunning. if they don't provide ACH in 72h fallback to card retry and immediate charge attempt.
tom (AE): Carl (Asterion finance) replied: accepts settlement terms, CFO will sign; prefers ACH; expects sign-and-return by EOD.
lena (Legal): ok i'll attach addendum and send to tom for final send. 
raj (Collections): once we have signed doc, ping me and i'll create plan. also FYI i'll put note in account: "collections hold pending settlement".
tom (AE): sending final email now. will post signed reply here once it's back. :pray:
